about: Build tasks for agents. One task = one branch = one PR. Fields: area (data/areas.json id), priority 1 (first) to 3, kind, photos to build from (public/photos-ref), build (what to make), avoid (what not to do), accept (checks that must pass, beyond the standard set in docs/HANDOVER.md), dependsOn (task ids), status open | in-progress | done, owner (agent or person working on it), issue (GitHub issue number in daveyboyc/villacana-venture; close it from the task's PR). scripts/build_references.py turns this into refs/QUEUE.md, per-area task lists, graph nodes and issue bodies in refs/issues/.

Lamps rechecked after the issue #35 retrace (PR #64): IMG_2352 and IMG_2350 show all four standing on the paving on base plates at the wall foot, shaft centre about 0.15 m from the face, not on the coping. The protected paseo route is 3 m wide with its landward edge on the wall face, the whole photographed paving (about 2.9-3.0 m), so each shaft centre lies about 0.3 m inside the guard and all four stay omitted (marked 'omitted' with the reason in data/paseo_details.json; check_paseo_details.py fails if one starts to clear). To finish: decide whether the protected paseo width should be the clear walk beside wall-foot fixtures (about 2.7 m) rather than the full paving; that is a data/paseo_wall.json route change, then drop 'omitted' and the lamps place themselves.

tasks.title: Raised terraces: a reusable module, first used for the north pool west terrace and its tiled stair
tasks.build: Most houses sit at lane level; what is raised is the ground in front of some of them (patios and terraces 0.25-1.1 m up, reached by one to six steps). Add one data file and module for raised terraces: an outline, a floor height above the ground (siteY), faces (white render or sandstone, with coping), openings with a stair (riser count) and a walkable flag; the player's groundHeight follows the floor inside a walkable terrace; faces collide except at openings; draw it on the blueprint. First use: the north pool west terrace, about 1 m (6 risers) above the path round the lawn, with its red-and-blue tiled stair and iron handrail at the north-west corner of the lawn and the curved white retaining wall beside it holding a planted bank. Position is low confidence (about (-187, 17.5) +-6 m from two roof bearings): trace it against the aerial and the registry houses before building. Heights: data/levels_survey.json item north-pool-west-stair.
tasks.avoid: Do not raise the lawn, deck or pool (pools stay level). Do not lift houses: the terrace is the ground in front of them. Do not generalise the terrace height to other patios without their own photos.
accept: layout browser test climbs the stair one riser at a time and walks the terrace
